meta.title: Primordial Paradox music recipes, twelve composer techniques (Kondo, Tanaka, Uematsu, Sugiyama, Yamashita, Matsumae, Suzuki, Shimomura, Mitsuda, Sakuraba, Yamane, Wise)
meta.citation_note: Every recipe cites source ids from knowledge/music-styles/composers.md section 19. Full titles, URLs and read dates live there, not here, because this directory is scanned by the project's clean-room gate.
meta.chip: NES 2A03 (2 pulse, triangle, noise, DPCM) plus the Konami VRC6 expansion where a recipe says so

conventions.frames: one frame is 1/60 s (16.7 ms) on NTSC; at 120 bpm a beat is 30 frames, an eighth 15 and a sixteenth 7.5, so sixteenth grids use 7 and 8 frame alternation
conventions.volume: 16 steps, 0 to 15; a 2 step change is audible, a 1 step change is not
conventions.guard: every generated melody passes tools/melody_guard.py before use

recipes.name: Cell plus step transposition
recipes.when_to_use: Any overworld, menu or title cue that needs a second phrase without new material. The default answer phrase in this idiom.

params.placement: cell in bars 1 to 2, transposed cell in bars 3 to 4
params.channels: pulse1 melody, pulse2 harmony, triangle bass

forbidden: changing the chord quality with the transposition, which breaks the hand shift effect
transposing by more than a whole step in the same section
transposing a cell that is longer than one bar
reusing the exact horn call shape of the Super Mario Bros overworld cell

recipes.name: Parallel voice leading, same shape new root
recipes.when_to_use: A chord change inside a phrase where a full progression would cost too many notes or too many frames. Two chords, one shape.

params.register: pulse1 and pulse2 within 12 semitones of each other
params.triangle: root of each chord on the strong beat

forbidden: contrary motion in both voices at once here, which is CMP-16 instead
three or more consecutive chords moved this way, which reads as a machine
a chord quality change on the move

recipes.name: Tempo locked to movement
recipes.when_to_use: Before writing any gameplay cue. Pick the tempo from the player cycle (walk, run, swim, menu blink), not from taste.

params.rule: one bar must equal a whole number of movement cycles or a simple fraction of one
params.verification: count frames of the walk cycle, divide by frames per bar, result within 0.5 of an integer

forbidden: keeping a tempo that does not divide the movement cycle, which was Kondo's own reason for discarding drafts
tempos between 126 and 144 bpm for menu cues, which read as neither calm nor urgent

recipes.name: Organ three part split
recipes.when_to_use: Any cue that has to sound full with three voices only. Assign each voice a body part and never let two share a job.

params.pulse2: left hand, chord or countermelody, duty 0.25
params.triangle: pedal, sustained root or stepwise bass
params.handover: when pulse2 takes the tune for 2 bars, pulse1 drops to chord duty 0.125

forbidden: both pulses playing the same rhythm at the same pitch class
the triangle leaving its register for a melody note above the pulses
a fourth voice implied by an arpeggio on all three channels at once

recipes.name: Compound metre ostinato identity
recipes.when_to_use: A dungeon, cave or tension cue that must be recognisable from two bars with no melody memory at all.

params.channel: pulse2 ostinato, pulse1 free for fragments
params.melody_density: no more than 2 notes per bar in the first 4 bars

forbidden: a 4/4 drum pattern underneath the 6/8 ostinato
a melody that also groups in 3, which removes the cross rhythm
using this metre twice in the same area

recipes.name: Noise as motif carrier
recipes.when_to_use: An intro, a bridge or a whole atmosphere cue where the noise channel states the motif before a pulse takes it.

params.noise_rate: periodic mode off, one rate per hit
params.pitch_tracking: three distinct noise pitches mapped to the three main degrees of the motif
params.handover: pulse1 repeats the same rhythm at the same accents, one octave up
params.volume: noise at 10 to 13, pulse at 12 initially

forbidden: using noise as a melodic voice for more than 4 bars, which reads as a drum solo
an untuned noise slide on the peak note of the motif
the same noise figure under a full drum pattern

recipes.name: Repeated note pulse with one frame gap
recipes.from: Hirokazu Tanaka and the Konami and Capcom houses
recipes.when_to_use: Any insistent melody where identity should come from rhythm rather than pitch travel. Measured at about one interval in six across Mother and the rock family.

params.repeat_count: 2 to 4 notes on the same pitch
params.volume: re-trigger at level 13 on each repeat, drop to 11 on the last
params.placement: on the strong beat of bars 1 and 3
params.share_target: 15 to 17 percent of all melody intervals in the cue

forbidden: repeats with no gap, which fuse into one long note
more than 4 repeats in a row without an ornament
repeated notes on the bass channel, where they read as a stuck note

recipes.name: Sus4 as a structural chord
recipes.when_to_use: The colour chord of a cue. Measured as one chord in five in the Mother corpus, second only to plain major.

params.chord: sus4 on the tonic, subdominant or flat seven
params.resolution: to the major triad on beat 3, only on the last bar of the phrase
params.melody: the fourth degree held or repeated over the chord

forbidden: sus4 on a strong beat of the final bar of a loop
sus4 and sus2 in the same phrase
resolving every sus4, since the unresolved one is the colour

recipes.name: Chord via arpeggio on one pulse
recipes.when_to_use: Whenever a triad has to exist with only two free channels. The harmony channel plays one note at a time.

params.register: between the melody and the bass, at least 5 semitones below the melody
params.restart: on every chord change, never carried across
params.volume: 11 to 13, at least 2 steps below the lead

forbidden: 1 frame per note on a slow cue, which reads as a buzz rather than a chord
arpeggiating the same chord for a whole bar without a rhythm
putting the arpeggio on the melody channel
two channels arpeggiating at once

recipes.name: Late quiet second voice, harp echo
recipes.when_to_use: A calm, magical or menu cue that needs to sound like two instruments rather than one doubled line.

params.delay: one eighth note, 15 frames at 120 bpm
params.rare_exception: change the last note of the second voice only, once per 8 bars

forbidden: delaying by more than one eighth, which reads as a mistake
putting the delay on the bass
quantising the delay onto the grid, which removes the effect

recipes.name: Narrow insistent riff over rich changes
recipes.when_to_use: A battle or boss cue that has to feel complex without a wide melody. Range stays small, harmony does the work.

params.chord_vocabulary: minor seventh, half diminished, diminished seventh, dominant seventh
params.bass: one pitch per beat, protected register

forbidden: a wide melody over this much chord change, which turns into mud
more than one accidental per bar in the melody
a drum fill in the first 4 bars

recipes.name: Secondary dominant every 8 bars
recipes.when_to_use: A cue that has settled into a key and needs a lift before the loop seam, without a modulation.

params.interval: every 8 bars, or every second statement of the phrase
params.choice: V of ii, V of vi or V of IV
params.melody: a raised note on the same beat, approached by step
params.resolution: immediately to the target chord, then home

forbidden: two secondary dominants in the same 8 bars
using it on the final bar of the loop
the melody leaping into the new chromatic note

recipes.name: Overture with a real return
recipes.when_to_use: The title theme, a credits cue, or any cue that will be heard once rather than looped.

params.material: the return restates the fanfare with the melody an octave up and the harmony a third higher
params.tempo: single tempo for all three sections

forbidden: new melodic material in the third section
a tempo change at the return
looping this form, which is why it is for a title cue and not a stage

recipes.name: Horn fifths approach figure
recipes.when_to_use: The house cadence. Two voices approaching a perfect interval at the end of a phrase.

params.motion: oblique or contrary into a perfect fifth or octave
params.placement: the last 2 beats of every 8 bar phrase
params.register: pulses in the middle register, triangle on the root

forbidden: using it on every phrase of a fast cue, where it reads as a formula
parallel perfect intervals for more than two moves
the figure in a cue with a rock drum kit under it

recipes.name: No note longer than an eighth
recipes.when_to_use: Any fast or martial cue, where sustain on the 2A03 thins out and exposes the envelope.

params.enforcement: split a longer note into two articulated notes with the same pitch and a 1 frame gap
params.exception: the final note of a section, up to a dotted quarter

forbidden: whole notes on a pulse channel
splitting a note in a way that changes the syncopation of the phrase
applying the rule to the pad in an atmosphere cue, which needs the opposite

recipes.name: Two leads, one beat apart, opposite contours
recipes.when_to_use: The main texture of a horror or action cue. Two square voices that answer rather than double.

params.contour: if the call rises, the answer falls, and the reverse
params.silence_rule: the calling voice rests while the answering voice speaks
params.pitch_tracking: 95 to 100 percent diatonic, one chromatic passing note allowed
params.bass: continuous, one note per eighth, no rest

forbidden: both voices playing the same rhythm
the answer starting on the same beat as the call
a third voice joining this texture before bar 9

recipes.name: Sixteen bar loop, unbroken bass pulse
recipes.when_to_use: Stage and boss cues where the loop has to be felt as a machine that does not stop.

params.bass: triangle, one pitch per eighth, no rests except the last eighth of bar 16

forbidden: a bass rest inside bars 1 to 15
a bass note held longer than an eighth in this cue type
a range under 24 semitones here, which leaves the texture too plain

recipes.name: Flat seven colour chord
recipes.when_to_use: A minor cue that has to sound gothic or threatening rather than sad.

params.chord: major triad on the flat seventh degree
params.melody: the flat seventh sounded on the first beat of the chord
params.bass: root of the flat seven, approached by step from below

forbidden: the flat seven in the final bar of the loop, which weakens the return
flat seven and a raised seventh in the same phrase
using it in a major key cue

recipes.name: One modulation per cue, melody keeps its shape
recipes.when_to_use: The B section of a stage cue that is running out of ideas without a modulation.

params.target: up a whole step or to the relative major
params.melody_rule: same intervals, new absolute pitches, no new motif
params.prep: one bar of a dominant chord in the new key before the move

forbidden: two modulations in one loop
a modulation in the last 4 bars
introducing new melodic material at the modulation

recipes.name: Channel budget, one reserved for harmony
recipes.when_to_use: Arrangement planning for every cue. Decides what gets dropped when the score gets dense.

thinning_order: pulse2 arpeggio to one note per beat

forbidden: borrowing the harmony channel for a countermelody mid phrase
thinning the melody to fit an arpeggio
all four channels at maximum density for more than 4 bars

recipes.name: Pop phrase with a breath rest
recipes.when_to_use: A town, house or character cue that should feel sung rather than played.

params.rest: one eighth to one quarter of silence at the end of the phrase, melody voice only
params.phrase_shape: 2 bars of statement, 1 bar of development, 1 bar of breath
params.harmony: one chord per bar, major sevenths and added sixths allowed

forbidden: a rest longer than a quarter note in a 4 bar phrase
a harmony change inside the breath bar
the accompaniment filling the rest on the same channel

recipes.name: Percussion as arrangement, not as a kit
recipes.when_to_use: Any cue that wants groove without a rock kit, especially towns and cutscene cues.

params.channel: noise plus one pulse for a tom
params.tom_pulse: triangle or pulse2 at a low pitch with a 3 frame volume staircase
params.pattern: hand pattern on offbeats, tom on beats 2 and 4, no continuous hats

forbidden: a rock backbeat under this pattern
hats on every eighth, which turns it into a kit
more noise hits than melody notes

recipes.name: Motif as a game mechanic
recipes.when_to_use: A collectible, a memory sequence, or an ending cue where repetition should be motivated by story.

params.assembly: each fragment is the next bar of the full motif, same key, same tempo
params.reuse: the same motif appears in the title cue at half volume

forbidden: a fragment that does not loop into the next one
changing key between fragments
stating the full motif before the payoff scene

recipes.name: Three plus three in a four bar frame
recipes.when_to_use: One cue per score, as the character theme or the boss intro. It makes the ear stumble in a good way.

params.accent: the first beat of the third bar of each unit

forbidden: two cues with an odd grouping in the same area
a 5 bar or 7 bar unit, which reads as an editing error rather than a device
an odd unit in a menu loop

recipes.name: Major bed under a minor melody
recipes.when_to_use: A character or stage cue that needs a bright surface and a sad centre, held for a whole section.

params.backing: major key, rhythm led, one chord per bar, duty 0.25
params.clash: only the third degree differs, so one note per bar disagrees
params.resolution: bars 9 to 16 either agree or repeat the clash

forbidden: changing the backing to minor mid section
a second clash, such as a major seventh over a minor tonic
this device on a battle cue, where the harmony needs to move faster

recipes.name: Bass priority rule
recipes.when_to_use: Every cue with story weight, and every cue where a sound effect may play over the music.

params.bass_register: at least 12 semitones below the lowest melody note
params.strong_beats: bass always sounds on beats 1 and 3
params.pitch_clarity: no bass note shorter than an eighth
params.volume: triangle at maximum, since the triangle has no volume control on the 2A03
params.melody_rule: the melody never crosses into the bass octave

forbidden: a melody note below the bass
a bass rest on beat 1 of a section start
an arpeggio in the bass register

recipes.name: Same sus4 shape, opposite bass direction
recipes.when_to_use: A pair of cues, or a cue and its reprise, where one should feel like going forward and the other like going back.

params.chord_family: sus4, then sus4 with a raised bass, then sus4 with a bass a semitone below
params.bass_motion_forward: up a whole step, then up a semitone
params.bass_motion_back: up a whole step, then back down a semitone
params.key_shift: the reprise may sit a semitone lower

forbidden: resolving the sus4 in either cue
changing the upper voices between the two versions
using this pair inside one loop, where the contrast has no time to land

recipes.name: Substitute chords so minor stops sounding minor
recipes.when_to_use: A minor key cue that needs to avoid the default sad sound, especially a hero or travel theme.

params.substitutions: flat VI for i every 4 bars, ii half diminished for iv, a major triad on the flat two for one beat
params.melody: stays diatonic to the natural minor
params.bass: root of the substitute on the strong beat

forbidden: more than two substitutes in 4 bars
substituting the final chord of the loop
the melody following the substitute chromatically, which removes the modal ambiguity

recipes.name: Hand played timing spread
recipes.when_to_use: Every cue that has to read as performed. Applied after the score is finished, as a pass.

params.which_voices: melody and harmony only, never the bass downbeat
params.distribution: 70 percent on time, 20 percent one frame late, 10 percent one frame early
params.volume_spread: plus or minus 1 step per note
params.note_length_spread: plus or minus 1 frame on notes longer than an eighth
params.maximum_per_bar: 3 deviations, and never on every note

forbidden: deviation on the bass, which destroys the groove
a fixed alternating pattern of deviations, which is just another grid
more than 3 frames, which reads as a mistake

recipes.name: Limb written drum part with an improvised fill
recipes.when_to_use: A battle or boss cue that needs a drummer rather than a loop.

limbs.kick: noise or DPCM on beats 1 and 3
limbs.snare: noise with periodic mode off, beats 2 and 4

params.fill_content: one limb breaks the pattern, the others keep it
params.variation: the hats change rate once per section

forbidden: all three limbs filling at once
the kick pattern changing inside a section
a fill in the last bar of the loop, which breaks the seam

recipes.name: Genre declared, then baroque semiquaver engine
recipes.when_to_use: A gothic, castle or boss cue. One line declares the world, then the engine runs underneath.

params.declaration: one of classical, metal or regional, written before any note
params.engine: triangle or VRC6 saw, one note per sixteenth, continuous, stepwise with occasional thirds
params.rock: noise backbeat with kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4
params.boss_variant: the lead becomes a soloist, phrases of 8 to 16 bars, sequences up twice before breaking

forbidden: mixing two declarations in one cue
a semiquaver engine with rests inside a bar, which stops it reading as baroque
the lead playing the same rhythm as the engine

recipes.name: Bassline first, off grid echo, semitone clash
recipes.when_to_use: An underwater, night, space or dream cue. A slow atmospheric cue that still has to be memorable.

params.pad: VRC6 saw with a slow staircase swell, attack 8 frames
params.echo: a quieter copy of the lead, 3 to 6 frames late, on the other pulse, delay deliberately not quantised
params.clash: the tonic and the raised tonic sounding together inside a major seventh chord, resolved only at the section change
params.loop_length: about 2 minutes before returning to section two

forbidden: quantising the echo delay
a drum kit in the first section
resolving the semitone clash early
a melody in the same register as the bass
